blazers.pulse: Portland is 2-0 after a 128-120 comeback win in Sacramento, its first road win of the year. It wasn't pretty, though: the Blazers needed a 44-point third quarter, and Blazer's Edge was rough on a defense the Kings drove right through. Fans will take the W and worry about the defense later.
storylines: Deni Avdija led with 26 points, 6 rebounds and 6 assists; Lillard and Toumani Camara had 19 each
A 15-0 third-quarter run flipped it, and Avdija iced it at the line after Sacramento got within 121-118
Defense was the worry: Sabonis had 27, 19 and 10, and Kings rookie Darius Acuff Jr. scored 33
Next up: at the Lakers on Tuesday, 8 PT on NBC and Peacock

timbers.pulse: Tonight feels like the last real shot. The Timbers (9-14-7, 34 points) are tied for 11th in the West and winless in seven. They host Charlotte, who can lock up a playoff spot with just a draw, so fans want a win and aren't expecting much.
storylines: Charlotte at Providence Park tonight, 7:30 PT on Apple TV
First-ever Charlotte visit to Portland; Charlotte has won both previous meetings
Kristoffer Velde has been the bright spot with 17 goal contributions
Watch Charlotte's Idan Toklomati, who has a club-record 13 goals
Previews are split between a 2-1 Timbers win and a 1-1 draw

f1.pulse: Ferrari owned Friday in Austin, with Charles Leclerc topping both practices, but Kimi Antonelli was only 0.042s back in FP2. Qualifying is today at 2 PT, and Antonelli can clinch the title in Sunday's race.
storylines: Antonelli leads Russell by 102 and clinches Sunday with a win if Russell is 9th or lower and Hamilton is 5th or lower
Leclerc led FP1 and FP2; Verstappen was 2nd and 3rd, Russell 5th in FP2
Antonelli pitted in practice to fix a seat that was moving too much
Stewards cleared Russell after a moment where Leclerc went off track
The bumpy COTA surface is tripping drivers up on qualifying runs
